Each server can now have a **public status page** that anyone can open without signing in, at `/s/<server name>` on your panel's address. It shows the server's name, icon and MOTD, a description you write, whether it's up, the address to join with a copy button, the Minecraft version, and either how many players are on, their names and heads, or nothing, as you choose. It uses your branding, and Discord and other sites show a preview when the link is shared. Turn it on from the server's **Settings**, **Public page**, or with `public:` in the YAML. Visitors never reach the Minecraft server: who's online comes from the server's log.

On Fabric servers the page also offers a **modpack** (`.mrpack`) that players open in the Modrinth app or Prism Launcher to get the right Minecraft, Fabric and mods in one go. It holds the server's Modrinth mods that run on players' computers, plus client-only extras you add, such as Sodium, Iris or a shader pack. Files are listed by their Modrinth downloads, never copied, and the pack is rebuilt whenever the server's content changes. See [Public status page](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.2.0-beta.2/docs/status-page.md).

Testing notes are in the "Public status page" and "Modpack for players" sections of [testing-1.2.0.md](https://github.com/MattA-Official/mc-panel/blob/v1.2.0-beta.2/docs/testing-1.2.0.md).
